No code reads this file: measure_streets and build_context reproduce the county byte for byte with it removed. Two merge entries were dropped as redundant, Scott's Subdivision and Randall, because the ordinal rule already groups and labels both identically. Kept only until AP has read judgement.py and agrees it is complete; git history holds this file either way.
_about: Subdivision merges judged by AP and applied by Claude from chat rulings. Hand judgement, not regenerable. No pipeline stage writes this file.
_rule: Bases listed together are one naming act. The family distance split still applies afterwards, so a listed base sitting far from the rest stays separate on its own -- that is deliberate, and is how Seamans 02nd stays out of Seaman's.

directional._rule: A base that is another base plus a trailing NORTH/SOUTH/EAST/WEST is the same naming act, when the two are within the family distance.
directional._skip_why: Both were judged apart on theme in phase_merges.json: Harris Ranch has 26 sawmill names against 6 birds, and merging through the Shelburne parent would make two unrelated developments peers. Pending AP's ruling on whether distance now overrides that.

possessive._about: Ordinal filings are overwhelmingly families platting their own land -- 62% of pre-1950 ordinals carry a possessive surname against 5% of NO/UNIT filings. The assessor is inconsistent about the apostrophe and sometimes drops the S entirely (BLASERS 01ST then BLASER 02ND, eleven months apart), so this is judgement, not a rule. A name mapped to null takes the comma form instead: 'South Boise, 2nd Addition'.
possessive._uncertain: resolved by AP 2026-09-12: Humphreys and Bell are not possessive; Bower's, Sety's, Georgianna Milk's and Mrs. A. M. Wilson's are.
possessive._not_people: place or compound names, and personal names with no trailing S -- these take the comma form

number_style._about: Names whose filings read as one numbered sequence regardless of how the assessor wrote each. The value is the canonical head. Blaser ran 1st, 2nd, then NO 03-09 across four locations, dropping the possessive partway; AP: standardise to Blaser #1, #2 and so forth. This is labelling only -- the geographic split into four subdivisions stands.

exclude._about: Plats that are not a development of their own. AP 2026-09-12: HYDE PARK ADD LIGHTS ADD modifies part of the two additions it names rather than adding anything, and is being removed from OpenStreetMap for the same reason.

subtitle._about: A marketing subtitle filed after the phase number, lifted out so it sits after the designation instead of inside the development's name. Keyed by base. A regex cannot find these: 'DE MEYER ESTATES SUB NO 03 THE REDWOODS' is a subtitle while 'WOODS NO 02 AT RIVERSIDE THE SUB' is a name the designation interrupts, and they are the same shape.
